MonkeyChatRequest.title: MonkeyChatRequest
MonkeyChatRequest.description:
The conversation so far, oldest first; the last message is the learner's. The server
keeps no chat history: the client sends it (only the latest turns reach the model).
`preferences` is optional: the client keeps the ones returned by the previous reply.
Without it, preferences are rebuilt from the commands in the history ("từ giờ…").

changes.title: Changes
changes.description: Settings changed by this message, e.g. "Chat: English"

MonkeyPolicyView.title: MonkeyPolicyView
MonkeyPolicyView.description: What this reply actually used (auto resolved).

MonkeyPreferences.title: MonkeyPreferences
MonkeyPreferences.description:
How AI Monkey teaches: the chat language, the language of explanations and
corrections (auto = follow the learner), and how much it corrects. Teaching modes are
presets of the three languages; `custom` is any other combination.

parts.title: Parts
parts.description: Scores of the skills graded from this one answer (spoken answers: grammar and fluency); empty when the answer trains a single skill

ReviewQuestionView.title: ReviewQuestionView
ReviewQuestionView.description: A question with its answer: for reviewers only, never sent to learners.

rating.description: Again / Hard / Good / Easy -> SM-2 quality 1/3/4/5

answer.title: Answer
answer.description: Optional typed answer; caps the rating if wrong

weeks_left.title: Weeks Left
weeks_left.description: answers_left at the daily goal, in weeks

Role.title: Role
Role.description: What an account may do. Stored on the user; never taken from a request.
